Set up Iris Unlock

Hold the phone 25–30 cm (10–12 in) from your face and look at the top of the phone, where the iris camera and the infrared light are.\n\nKeep your eyes wide open. If your glasses cause reflections, you may need to take them off. Iris Unlock also works in the dark thanks to infrared light.
Hold the phone 25–30 cm (10–12 in) from your face and look at the top of the phone. Keep your eyes open until setup is complete.

Use your iris to unlock your phone. Apps that need a strong biometric, like banking and payment apps, can’t use Iris Unlock.
Use your iris to unlock your phone or for authentication in apps, like when you sign in to apps or approve a purchase
Keep in mind
If your glasses reflect the infrared light, your iris may not be recognized. In that case, take them off.
Looking at the phone can unlock it even when you don’t intend to. Your phone can also be unlocked by someone else if it’s held up to your open eyes.
Using your iris to unlock your phone may be less secure than a strong pattern, PIN, or password
Your eyes must be open and looking at the top of the phone. Iris Unlock also works in the dark thanks to infrared light.
How it works
Iris Unlock uses the infrared camera and light at the top of the phone to take pictures of your eyes and create an iris model. Your iris model is encrypted and stored only on this phone.
You’re in control
You can delete your iris model or turn off Iris Unlock at any time in Settings.
You can unlock your phone using your iris. For security, this option requires a backup screen lock.
